The "I can fix her/him" culture refers to when a person begins a relationship
or maintains a romantic relationship with someone who has clear emotional or
behavioral problems with the conscious idea of "fixing" them or changing them
for the better.

Demonizing means portraying this culture as excessively harmful and dangerous.
motions.text: TH supports the demonization of the "I can fix her/him" culture

motions.info_slide_plain:
In the Social Sciences, there are two predominant methodological approaches to
investigating social phenomena: the quantitative method and the qualitative
method.

The quantitative method is based on the collection and analysis of numerical
data. It employs statistical tools, structured surveys, and econometric models
to measure variables, identify patterns, and establish causal relationships.
It works with large samples, and its main objective is to generalize findings
to broader populations. In contrast, the qualitative method focuses on
understanding meanings, motivations, and experiences from the perspective of
the social actors themselves. It uses tools such as in-depth interviews, focus
groups, and participant observation. It works with small samples, aiming to
deeply understand social phenomena in specific contexts.
motions.text: This House prefers the predominant use of quantitative research methodology over qualitative methodology in the Social Sciences.

motions.info_slide_plain:
In the CONMEBOL Libertadores, prize money is distributed in a "concentrated"
manner. The champion takes 8.7% of the total prize pool (USD 18 million), the
runner-up 3.4% (USD 7 million), and each semifinalist 1.1% (USD 2.3million),
etc., within a global prize pool of USD 207.8 million

The UEFA Champions League distributes its funds in a“dispersed” manner: the
champion receives just 1% of the fund (USD 27.8 million), the runner-up 0.76%
(USD 20.5 million), and the remaining percentages are also distributed among
the semi-finalists, quarter-finalists, and group stage teams, so that even
clubs that do not reach the final rounds receive significant income.
motions.text: THW implement a dispersed distribution system in the CONMEBOL Libertadores

motions.info_slide_plain:
You are a female lawyer and partner at one of the largest law firms in your
Latin American country. Reviewing some documents, you discovered that the
other partners were making administrative moves to take a significant portion
of your profits.

In this context, you learn of a plot by other high-ranking lawyers to take
power away from the firm's owner and put a young, principled lawyer in charge.

Thus, you have two options to further your career:

  * Option 1: You have been offered to join the plot and become second-in-command (you would be the only woman with that rank in the country).
  * Option 2: You have been offered a position as head of a department at another law firm, where you can rise gradually (you would leave the firm quietly, giving up all the money that was unfairly deducted from you).
motions.text: EC prefers to join the plot rather than accept the competition's offer.

motions.info_slide_plain:
The "truth purification" paradigm conceives scientific development as a
process of systematically discarding falsified theories in order to approach
an increasingly accurate body of knowledge. In contrast, the "complementary
science" paradigm proposes preserving and exploring historical theories as
alternative perspectives that coexist with current models, emphasizing the
contingency of knowledge and the possibility of multiple concurrent
explanations.
motions.text: TH prefers a world where science is built under the paradigm of "complementary science" instead of the paradigm of "truth purification" through the rejection of falsified theories.

motions.info_slide_plain:
Following the creation of the 1993 Political Constitution of Peru, there was a
shift in the economic role of the State. Unlike the 1979 Constitution, which
had a welfare-oriented approach, the 1993 Constitution adopts a subsidiary
role for the State in the economy.
motions.text: THBT the shift in the State's economic approach has done more harm than good.
